notes.title: Compatibility patch 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you have been enjoying [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] ːsotaloveː
Today's patch introduces an array of improvements for Steam Deck users. I originally wanted the patch to include [i]more[/i] compatibility adjustments, but split it in two to ship a bugfix earlier.

Without further ado, here are the patchnotes:
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that made the 'Charchoal and flowers' scenario play twice. This was caused by a very specific sequence of events/choices, so it took me a while to narrow down!
[*] Minor fixes to the Envoy's portrait in the stat menu;
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Made the map UI controller-friendly;
[*] Unified the look of the various textboxes and made them compatible with 16:10 screens. While this was made with the Steam Deck in mind, the fix will apply to all 16:10 screens!
[*] Made adjustments to the stat UI to make it compatible with 16:10 screens;
[/list]
[b]Added on Nov 16[/b]
[list]
[*] The Skitter Skitter achievement should now trigger properly;
[*] Fixed some continuity issues when returning to Nessa after Lord Rizzo's [spoiler]death[/spoiler];
[/list]
The second patch will introduce more UI reactivity to controller (like sounds) and better/more shortcuts.

[h3]Updated pricing for Poland[/h3]
Some users pointed out that Steam's regional pricing tool was exceptionally unfair towards Poland. The game was more expensive there than in Western Europe, despite the country having less purchasing power. This seems to be a well-documented error of the regional pricing tool, which I manually corrected. The price has now been adjusted to zł 64.99!

Thank you for playing ːsotawinkː

notes.title: Devlog: heaps of progress ✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you are all doing great!

It's time for a [b]public project update[/b], and this one is jam-packed with [b]news[/b] and lots of little [b]sneak peeks[/b] ✨ 

[h2]A lovely addition to the key art[/h2]
Players who tried the demo noticed that despite being promoted to [b]love-interest[/b], Ascanio was still [b]absent[/b] from the key art... that's not the case anymore!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/adf15c757991565865e70c73cb2c23cffdf77e7e.png[/img]
Aside from his addition, everybody received some [b]extra love[/b]. The key art was already beautiful, but it's now [b]perfect[/b]!

Ah, and... once you complete the game, something might [b]change[/b] in the title screen🤭

[h2]Carolise's new wardrobe[/h2]
Work on the [b]sprites [/b]has been [b]completed[/b]! This included new [b]arm poses[/b], [b]expressions[/b] and, in some cases, [b]outfits[/b].

The main character got the most love with [b]two additional outfits[/b]—a lavish dress in green velvet and a pretty blouse for the hottest months ahead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/04c0bcda546e4b0774fe889b864325766a8ae253.png[/img]
[b]Enilia[/b], the resident seamstress, can help you acquire both!

She can also help you come up with a gift for [b]Sylas[/b]—a new blouse to replace her threadbare one! This outift is [b]exclusive [/b]to Sylas' romance😃
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/3427a02e09d5ad3aa548dd4050c8e1910952d7b4.png[/img]
More characters got their wardrobes spruced up, but I am going to keep some things a mystery! 😀

[h2]Development progress[/h2]
It something is not on the list (like background art), it's because it has been completed and implemented ✨ here's what still needs to be done:

[b]Proofreading[/b]: only the last chapters still need to be proofread!

[b]Voice line recording[/b]: almost completed! Once I have all the lines, audio-editing will begin in earnest. 

[b]Implementation[/b]: this process takes the word script and turns it into code, checking for logic, variables and whatnot. Not the most exciting part of the job, but it's the backbone of the game!

[h1]Release date clarification[/h1]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] will release [b]around September[/b]! No fixed date yet, but I will publicly announce one as soon as I'm able to!

[h2]Thank you again for your support! [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/
And see you next month with another devlog ✨

notes.title: Play the voiced demo now!
notes.content:
Surprise! [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] joins the Steam Next Fest with a [b]voiced demo[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/ef26b0c93b6127f67892faaa45de106e0b223e47.png[/img]
The [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is an event centered around upcoming games and their demos. 
It's a treasure trove of incredible gems, and every year I have a blast discovering new games to look forward to ✨ I'm really excited to join this year—it's my first Next Fest as a developer!

I had these four goals in mind while crafting the demo:
[list]
[*] [b]Concise[/b] and [b]accessible[/b]: I wanted it to be a somewhat contained experience that doesn't alienate new players who have not experienced [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] / are not familiar with the characters.
[*] A [b]showcase[/b] of the [b]voice acting[/b]: 70% of the demo is voiced, so I'm pretty pleased with the end result.
[*] I was keen to[b] introduce Ascanio[/b] to everyone. He's the only love interest not featured in [i]Shadow Bonds[/i], and I wanted everyone to meet him, especially because he became a love interest thanks to the support of the Kickstarter backers.
[*] I really wanted to show [b]more [/b]of the [b]romances[/b]!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/e4c0fed1a4e3e8fb13cbc8e5a972cba1d43df654.gif[/img]
While the demo is somewhat representative of the full game, it's also... not. 
[h3]Character creation has been simplified.[/h3]
You can customize the name of the Envoy and determine her personality in the demo, but her powers have been pre-determined since they are only featured in [u]one[/u] minor choice. 
This will not be the case in the full game—she will be fully customizable there, and her powers will have more impact!
[h3]Choices, branches and lines had to be cut to streamline the experience. [/h3]
This is the direct result of the new context behind some scenes! 
A major choice has also been cut. In the full game, [spoiler]infiltrating the Halls[/spoiler] is not mandatory! You can also heed Sylas' pleas, let the matter rest & find a subtler way to find out what happened. This slow-burn approach spans multiple days and is not voiced, so it was cut from the demo.
When you play the full game, events [b]will play differently[/b]!
[h3]Three romance options are available in the demo.[/h3]
You'll be able to enjoy the company of Sylas, Alpheon and Malec. Their scenes have been taken from early in the game, before committing yourself to your beloved, and feature variations based on your romantic preferences ✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/

I hope you will enjoy the demo! I would love to know what you think ːcharmwitchː
I have created a new section in the forums to collect feedback—you can find it in the game's main hub.

Have a lovely day! ✨

notes.title: Sigh of the Abyss joins the Storyteller's Festival ✍️
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are all doing well 😃
Today's announcement is jam-packed with information—let's dive right in!
[h2]Release date[/h2]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] has a release date! Mark your calendars, the game will become available [b]June 26[/b]! 
A [b]new[/b] voiced demo will release some weeks prior as well, and I will try to make save files compatible between the main game & the new demo!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/0d78a82566ae5811d1b78e4f9e7240e25854a16b.png[/img]
Sigh of the Abyss will be priced at $17.99 / € 17.49 / £ 14.99 £ / A$ 26.50 / CDN$ 23.49 (and make use of Steam's regional pricing tool 😃).
[h2]Progress[/h2]
All the backgrounds of the game are complete, and so is the soundtrack! 
Have a taste of both in this video about the sights and sounds of Carolise:
[previewyoutube=ICqbK-8udtM;full][/previewyoutube]
I am currently editing the script, which is also being looked at by the proofreader. It's... 396k words in total?! 😳
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/16542989e366848d11c121386c2f106bc98cf960.png[/img]
Once the script is ready, coding will begin in earnest, and selected scenes will be given to the VAs to receive voiced lines ✨
[h2]The Storyteller's Festival[/h2]
[i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] has been invited to the [b]Storyteller's Festival[/b]! If you enjoy narrative games, you can't miss this event! Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2024]festival's Steam page[/url] to discover amazing new games, demos & more ✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/d9c65cdc2a44557fad21ddfa0c78f1be03b617d7.png[/img]
[h2]Have you played [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] yet?[/h2]
[i]Shadow Bonds[/i] is the standalone prologue of Sigh of the Abyss—a self-contained experience that will introduce you to the characters & setting of the main game. Best of all, it's free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829640/Sigh_of_the_Abyss_Shadow_Bonds__Prologue/

I'll be sharing more about the game as the release date approaches. A wishlist not only helps [i]a ton[/i], it also ensures the game's announcements will show up in your library hub ✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025310/Sigh_of_the_Abyss/

Thank you so much for reading until here.
Toodles~

notes.title: June/July update ✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are all doing well😄 
I recently posted this update on Kickstarter; since it's public, I thought of sharing it on Steam as well!

- - - - - - - - - - - - - 

The [b]Summer Solstice[/b] passed by in a flash, and sweltering [b]July[/b] arrived in a blaze. 

In their starlit chambers, astronomers study the sky to announce the exact date of the [i]aphelion[/i]—the point of our planet's orbit that is farthest away from the Sun. Rumor has it that on that day, the influence of the [b]Triune Goddess[/b] wanes; the nobility revels in luxury without putting on a pious façade, leaving the Citadel for the shade of the Forester's Hide. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/a719189c4faa590de11e3b513938609be46375a1.png[/img]
Stretching between the river Valse and the city, the Forester's Hide is a vast woodland dotted with natural springs and pools. Its canopies give shelter to the rowdy boar, the laughing fox and the nocturnal dormouse—beasts to the peasant, but quarries to the nobles. The Hide is where they compete to prove their hunting prowess, returning with trophies to be devoured over a glass of wine or mounted on the wall.

Those that turn their eyes away from the hunt prefer to dance instead, with flowers in their hair and fur trimmed fineries; some chase love, others chase powerful alliances and political marriage.

What might bring the protagonist into this verdant realm of scheming and diplomacy?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/39ee07b13d5aafb82f7307c2f6e7748a88caa86c.png[/img]
[i]The reeds that surround the creek shield you from sight with their gentle dance.[/i]

If you have romanced Alpheon in [i]Shadow Bonds[/i] you might find the illustration above familiar, but there are some differences in the angle of his head and in the hand that cups his face, which brings me to...

[h2]Development progress[/h2]
After a short break, [b]character art and illustrations[/b] have picked up the pace again! Alongside new art, updates are being made to old pieces to have them fit the full game, like in the example above.

Most of the [b]OST [/b]is done, with only some arrangements left, and the majority of the [b]background art[/b] pieces have been completed as well. Woot woot 🎉 

When it comes to [b]writing[/b], this "Forester's Hide chapter" is a massive, branching monster of choices, consequences and some points of no return. I'm having a lot of fun working on it! The challenge is to keep the scope of this asset-heavy portion manageable (she says, already resigned to the fact that several characters will need a costume change).

[h2]Updated content warnings[/h2]
The content warnings here and on the Steam page will have to be updated to reflect the previous chapters and the den of debauchery I'm currently writing. Here they are:

[list]
[*]  [b]On screen[/b]: murder, suicide, blood, consensual discussion of sex, coarse language, legal prostitution, implied nudity, mind control;
[*]  [b]Text only[/b]: consensual sex, public execution, gore, legal alcohol consumption, stalking, poisoning, torture, infanticide;
[*]  [b]Mentioned/implied[/b]: kidnapping, domestic abuse, animal cruelty;
[/list]
[b]The game will not include sexual assault.[/b]

I wonder if a list like this would be enough, or perhaps it'd be better to be more detailed while still trying to keep spoilers to a minimum. Let me know if you have a strong preference for either way! 

[h2]And now, a palate cleanser...[/h2]
...in the form of a sneak peek~ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/c4acd3089d71ce67563fcad376bdfb7522585f16.gif[/img]
Alpheon, June's golden child, is featured in two of them this month 😉 I had to share more than one expression, so I turned it into a GIF (which looks better here than on Kickstarter!)

- - - - - - - - - - - - - 

Thank you for reading thus far! I'm so excited to share more of this world with you 😄

I'll see you in two months with the next public update which will be all about the game's sapphic options—Sylas and Marané! 
For now, toodles ✨

notes.title: Wishlist Sigh of the Abyss!
notes.content:
Spanning over ten chapters rippling with choices and consequences, [i]Sigh of the Abyss[/i] is a dark fantasy tale written in blood and shadows.
[previewyoutube=18ciMkipS7w;full][/previewyoutube]
You are the product of a bloody ritual; human in appearance, yet imbued with monstrous powers. The men and women that sacrificed their life for yours speak to you in whispers, beg you to put their spirits to rest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/805fc156f2fe6629410ee99920473550223f72e9.png[/img]
The sun-drenched Carolise hides centuries of treachery, ever-expanding and craving more. 
Take control of the city or let it explode in revolts and blood—it's up to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/039c1cf93750a6b4c67198dd7407cf3d9fce357e.png[/img]
Luckily, you're not alone. Friends, bitter rivals or even lovers... how will you shape the bonds with your companions?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/8e6f3ce0d6ce9964ffe1ec9245bf58f636ad9415.png[/img]
Sigh of the Abyss is currently in development, and is slated for a 2023 release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42552398/a942bcfb5d45dae09b15bbcfdaf357e97b84292c.png[/img]

Want to follow along with development? You can [url=https://rascaldev.works/landing/][b]sign up for the newsletter[/b][/url]!

Want to have a taste of what's to come? Play the standalone free prologue, [i]Shadow Bonds[/i]!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829640/Sigh_of_the_Abyss_Shadow_Bonds__Prologue/
